an3.67:6.7: “Sitting close” is _upanisā_ in the same original sense as the Sanskrit _upaniṣad_.
an3.67:12.4: Bodhi has “mendacious” for _payuta_, but in his later translation of the same line at snp3.11:33.4 he has “suggestive”. The word is obscure, but the commentary connects it with the idea of dropping hints and suggestions.
